result_text:
I fixed the "past 90d" block so it shows the LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I didn't compile or run any tests.

The block was formatting `loc180Days` for its LOC figure, even though `loc90Days` was already being computed and used for the percentage. The fix is a one-word change in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, around line 887. It now uses `loc90Days` for the LOC text too.

I haven't committed anything.
